title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened foundational learning systems by integrating multi-level pedagogy into national policies, curricula, and teacher training systems; supporting inclusive education; launching digital teacher competency programmes; and delivering learning recovery programmes benefitting about 160,000 children nationwide. New digital innovations were launched to further strengthen the education system, promote equity, and enhance learning.
